name: Blanco
description:
About This Game

Restore order to the crystal labyrinth!

Play as the curious cube-shaped character named Blanco and restore the sparkling crystals to their altars and escape the crystal labyrinth!

Blanco is a 3D Roguelite style game in which you take repeated trips into the crystal labyrinth, a maze that is constantly changing with each reset.

GAME FEATURES

  • Advanced 3D character movement control

  • Up-gradable items and abilities

  • 100+ player cosmetics to find and collect

  • 45 artwork collectibles to find and view in the gallery room

  • Replayability with fun gameplay, shuffling maze layouts, personal best time keeping, and completionist challenges

ABOUT THE CRYSTAL LABYRINTH

The crystal labyrinth is a maze that is always changing! The labyrinth is home to enemies that will stop at nothing to prevent you from solving it! Each trip through the crystal labyrinth is randomized in door placements and level layout.

SPARKLING CRYSTALS

Sparkling crystals are the key to the altars. There are 12 sparkling crystals in each maze. A sparkling gem is identified by its sparkling particles of the same color.

The sparkling crystals are found at the bottom of other crystal altars in the maze. A lost sparkling crystal will be at the bottom of a crystal altar, and a restored sparkling crystal will be resting at the top of the crystal altar.

CRYSTAL ALTARS

Crystal altars are the "gates" of the labyrinth that must be unlocked to solve a maze. There are 12 crystal altars in each maze—one for each sparkling crystal. To unlock a crystal altar, you must bring it a sparkling crystal that matches the color of the world the altar is in.

The Rainbow Crystal

When all the gates in a maze are unlocked, Blanco will receive a Rainbow Crystal. Blanco must carry this crystal back safely to the starting area. If the rainbow crystal is lost or destroyed, you must exit the maze and press the reset button to try and create a new one.

Blanco must bring this crystal to the large rainbow door that has the number imprinted on it, and throw or smash the crystal into the rainbow door. When this happens the number on the door will go down by 1. When the number reaches 0, you will be able to escape the crystal labyrinth!
